actual: MiniQMT open/terminal status semantics are inconsistent across modules: qmt_strategy_ledger/models.py:18 STATUS_OPEN_LIKE=50 (single value); scheduler.py:4703 _miniqmt_open_order_evidence counts open only when order_status==STATUS_OPEN_LIKE(50), so a partial-fill order (raw order_status=55, e.g. 603690.SH 2000 ordered/1800 filled) is NOT counted as open; but runtime.py:1587 treats {48,49,50,51,55} as open and minqmtsim.py:52-53 classifies {48,49,50,51} pending / {52,53,55} partial. When only partial-fill (55) orders remain, scheduler/ledger can mis-judge no-open-orders and prematurely terminalize the run or trigger a dependent BUY retry before the SELL fully fills -- unattended trading-safety hazard.

description: MiniQMT order open/terminal status semantics are inconsistent across modules -> unattended trading-safety hazard. qmt_strategy_ledger/models.py:18 STATUS_OPEN_LIKE=50 (single value); scheduler.py:4703 _miniqmt_open_order_evidence treats an order open only when order_status==STATUS_OPEN_LIKE(50), so a raw partial-fill order_status=55 (today 603690.SH 2000 ordered/1800 filled) is NOT counted as open. runtime.py:1587 treats {48,49,50,51,55} as open; minqmtsim.py:52-53 classifies {48,49,50,51} pending / {52,53,55} partial; sync_service.py:646 collapses 'not fully filled' to STATUS_OPEN_LIKE(50) in the ledger while scheduler reads the raw broker status. CONSEQUENCE: when only partial-fill(55) orders remain, scheduler/ledger can mis-judge no-open-orders and prematurely terminalize the run or trigger a dependent BUY retry before the SELL fully fills. FIX (A, P0 core): define ONE canonical non-terminal(open) vs terminal broker order_status predicate in qmt_strategy_ledger/models.py (pending 48/49/50/51 + partial 52/53/55 = non-terminal; terminal = 54 cancelled / 56 filled / 57 rejected) and use it everywhere incl. scheduler.py:4703 (count 55 as open) and sync_service lifecycle (remaining-qty aware). FIX (B, P1 within bug): runtime recover()/_sync_managed_child_result must reconcile child-order status from broker order/trade snapshots (FILLED/PARTIALLY_FILLED/CANCELLED) so runtime persisted state stops lagging broker truth (recovery/audit/operator-cancel/terminal judgment). No silent fallback. LocalSim untouched. SEQUENCING: overlaps scheduler.py with BUG-463/#1441(L2 LocalSim terminalizers); different functions (4703 MiniQMT evidence vs LocalSim terminalizers) but rebase whichever merges second. RELATED separate P1 to register: succeeded_with_capacity_residual must be surfaced in API/UI/alert (scheduler.py:4661/2300 allow SUCCEEDED with terminal_capacity_residual; top-level SUCCEEDED with failed_intents>0 is a monitoring false-positive).

events.note: Verified xtquant constants from vendored xtconstant.py: 48/49/50/51 pending, 52/53/55 partial non-terminal, 54/56/57 terminal. Added canonical qmt_strategy_ledger predicates, aligned scheduler open evidence/sync_service/runtime/client child-order reconciliation, and confirmed status 55 remains open. No LocalSim files, production runtime, DB, or DDL touched. Full qmt_strategy_ledger suite has two pre-existing/out-of-scope failures unrelated to BUG-470 allowed scope.
